conviction_note: Two measurements: findings sum to -0.8 (a public Q2 slowdown that peers' prints say hit margins, plus a 35-40% chance the 27.0bn OP plan is cut below a street sitting only 1% under it, against a stock already 8% off its high with margin shorts outnumbering longs); the scaled number is p_up 46 x abs 3.5 = -0.28, smaller because the miss is visible in the 月次 and Heiwado's held-plan H1 miss on 10/01 moved its stock only -0.9%.
bar: H1 operating profit vs IFIS consensus 14,189m yen (as of 2026-07-07, before the Q1 miss; https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/8194_20260708_act_20260708_113012_1). Current FY consensus OP 26,700m / ordinary 27,700m vs company plan 27,000m / 28,000m (kabuyoho, updated 2026-10-07: https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=8194). No company H1 plan exists. The H1 consensus is stale, so findings depending on it are capped small; my own H1 OP estimate is ~11.2-12.0bn from monthly sales and last year's Q2 cost base.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 0.75 (margin shorts exceed margin longs; scraped, baseline). No skew in Japan. Run-up -5.63% 20d, -3.23% 5d; ~-8% from the 2,782 high of 2026-09-04 (Yahoo chart). Consensus target 2,783 (+9%) per kabuyoho. priced_lean_pct +0.34.

findings.finding: Q2 (Jun-Aug) same-store sales slowed to -0.4% / +0.7% / +1.1% (all-store +0.3/+1.6/+2.1%) against Q1's +2.9% and an FY plan of +3.5% 既存店, on a cost base that grew 3.5% in Q1; with Q1 OP already -6.9%, Q2 OP is likely down roughly 15-30% yoy, taking H1 OP to ~11.2-12.0bn (41-44% of the 27.0bn plan vs 51% at H1 last year) and well below the July IFIS H1 14.2bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 (2026-07-08, 11:30): OP 7,230 vs IFIS 8,022, stock -5.98% (baseline). H1 FY26 (2025-10-07): OP +8.8%, roughly in line with IFIS 13,438, -2.97%. Four straight negative print reactions (-2.97, -0.75, -2.31, -5.98).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the 月次 are public and the stock has slid from 2,782 to 2,549. What is not obviously in the number is the margin side: FY ordinary consensus only moved 28.0bn -> 27.7bn (-1%, 2026-09-16) after a Q1 miss and a weaker Q2, so the street has not marked H1 down to what the sales and the cost base imply. If it had, the FY consensus would sit several percent under the plan rather than 1%.
findings.independence: Peer Heiwado (Kinki, same Jun-Aug quarter) reported H1 ordinary -17.6% and Q2 -18.2% with gross margin hit by the reversal of last year's rice and price-hike effects (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8276&b=k202610010002, 2026-10-01; tanshin https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261001/140120260930542868.pdf). Life's own Q1 gross margin was -0.3pt, -0.7pt in 加工・日配 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260708/140120260701586018.pdf). Different documents.

findings.finding: The FY OP plan of 27,000m (+3.8%) needs H2 OP of ~15bn against 12.7bn last year (+20%) on my H1 estimate, and street consensus (26,700m) sits only 1% under it, so a cut at this print would land below the street; Life held its plan at H1 last year and all through FY26, but cut at H1 in Oct 2022 when costs overshot.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-07: plan held 3.8% below IFIS, -2.97%. 2026-04-09: new FY plan 2.4% below IFIS, -2.31%. Revision record: up Jan 2024 (Q3), down at H1 Oct 2022 for energy costs (edinetdb list). Peer Heiwado held its plan on a -18% H1 on 2026-10-01 and moved -0.9% that day (2,586 -> 2,564).
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus has barely moved (28.0bn -> 27.7bn ordinary), which is what it looks like when the street expects the plan to be held. A cut to ~25-26bn OP would be news to that number. Against: Japanese supermarkets usually hold at H1 (Heiwado did, Halows did), and Life is mid-way through a 26.3bn tender for Albis that ends 2026-11-10, so it may defer any revision until it can consolidate Albis. My estimate is a 35-40% chance of a cut at this print.
findings.independence: Revision history from https://edinetdb.jp/company/E03083/earnings-forecasts/ (down Oct 2022, up Jan 2024, nothing since). Plan and H1 history from the Q1 tanshin https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260708/140120260701586013.pdf and the FY26 H1 reference doc https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251007/140120250925562019.pdf. Separate from finding 1's monthly-sales source, but the required H2 number uses finding 1's H1 estimate, so the two are linked.

findings.finding: Positioning leans toward 出尽くし: margin shorts exceed margin longs (信用倍率 0.75), the stock is ~8% off its 2026-09-04 high into the print with peers Heiwado and Halows sliding with it, and the consensus target is 2,783 after Okasan's 2026-08-05 upgrade to Buy (TP 2,900); a held plan and the guided 35-yen interim dividend would hit a short-leaning, de-rated tape.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not directly observed for this name; the last four prints all fell despite mixed content. Okasan's upgrade on 2026-08-05 was followed by +4.0% on 2026-08-06 (2,474 -> 2,573, Yahoo chart).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced by definition; this is the setup, not a fact about the print. It would be fully priced if the margin book were long-heavy or the stock sat at its high; instead the margin short side is the bigger one, which needs buying on any non-cut.
findings.independence: Margin ratio from the sealed baseline (broker scrape); price path from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/8194.T?range=3mo&interval=1d; consensus target from https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=8194.

findings.finding: The interim dividend is guided at 35 yen (from 32.5) toward a record 70 yen for the year, with a stated policy of a 30% payout and a 3% DOE; no buyback is likely while 26.3bn goes out for Albis, so the release is not expected to add a return item.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Year-end dividend raised 0.5 yen at the FY print on 2026-04-09; stock -2.31% that day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: this sits inside the company's own guide. It is filed at 0 because a dividend cut is the one returns item that would add news, and the DOE floor makes a cut unlikely.
findings.independence: Albis TOB funding of 26,334m yen from https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260908/140120260905532133.pdf

baseline_tension: Findings lean slightly negative, the same way as the -5.6% run-up and the slide in supermarket peers, so they mostly agree with what the tape has already done; the strongest positive the release could carry is a held 27.0bn plan plus the guided 35-yen interim, landing on a margin-short-heavy book (信用倍率 0.75) 8% off the high. I looked for buyback or 優待 changes and found no sign of either. The baseline's priced_lean (+0.34) points mildly up.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次 means p_up toward 50): the Q2 monthly-sales finding went from -0.8 to -0.5 and p_up from 42 to 46; the forecast-decision finding stays because it is what the release ADDS, trimmed from -1.0 to -0.8 since my base case is a held plan

Rule 2 (check the sign, write the strongest positive): positioning finding raised from +0.4 to +0.5 after setting out the held-plan / dividend / margin-short case in baseline_tension; I had already looked for a buyback, so p_up moved for rule 1 only
